cells.scope_note: Meat and poultry products hermetically sealed in a metal can and retort-processed: canned corned beef, canned luncheon meat and spiced ham, canned chicken and turkey, canned stewed and braised meat, canned meat pate and spread, and canned pet-food-adjacent human-grade meat. Canned fish and shellfish route to Category 6; canned soups, stews and complete meals whose meat content is one component among many route to Category 35; canned pet food routes to Category 17. THE TIN FLAG IS THIS ROW'S REASON TO EXIST: tin migrates from the internal surface of an unlacquered or damaged tinplate can into the food, so the canned-foods tin maximum level applies to this row and to no other row in Category 11.
